problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 8 delivery routes through 8 distribution hubs.

Each route consists of a predetermined sequence of hub stops represented as (Hub, Service time) pairs, where each pair specifies the hub where the truck must stop and the time required to complete the service. The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the hubs must be visited.

Route details:
* R1 follows the sequence: (H7, 6) → (H2, 5) → (H5, 2) → (H4, 1) → (H3, 7) → (H1, 5) → (H6, 6) → (H8, 10)
* R2 follows the sequence: (H4, 8) → (H3, 3) → (H8, 6) → (H2, 7) → (H1, 7) → (H6, 7) → (H5, 6) → (H7, 10)
* R3 follows the sequence: (H2, 8) → (H1, 4) → (H5, 7) → (H4, 2) → (H8, 7) → (H7, 1) → (H3, 5) → (H6, 10)
* R4 follows the sequence: (H3, 3) → (H8, 1) → (H7, 2) → (H5, 6) → (H1, 6) → (H6, 8) → (H2, 4) → (H4, 4)
* R5 follows the sequence: (H6, 7) → (H8, 1) → (H5, 2) → (H4, 1) → (H3, 2) → (H7, 6) → (H1, 4) → (H2, 5)
* R6 follows the sequence: (H2, 4) → (H5, 2) → (H3, 3) → (H1, 8) → (H7, 3) → (H6, 3) → (H8, 8) → (H4, 5)
* R7 follows the sequence: (H3, 2) → (H4, 2) → (H6, 5) → (H5, 2) → (H1, 7) → (H8, 4) → (H2, 5) → (H7, 7)
* R8 follows the sequence: (H4, 10) → (H8, 7) → (H6, 10) → (H5, 4) → (H3, 5) → (H1, 6) → (H2, 9) → (H7, 6)

Each truck must complete its service at a hub continuously once it begins, and each hub can only service one truck at a time. The objective is to determine the service schedule for all trucks at the hubs so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
